report:
Successfully reproduced the PMP boundary crossing bug in Machine mode (src/mmu/pmpchecker.sv). The issue was reproduced using a bug-triggering program (`test.elf`) where an 8-byte store instruction in Machine mode straddles across PMP0 (unlocked, RWX) and PMP1 (locked, read-only). Because `EnforcePMP` in `src/mmu/pmpchecker.sv` depends solely on the start address's lock bit, the access fault enforcement signal `EnforcePMP` evaluates to 0, completely suppressing `PMPBoundaryStoreFault`. Consequently, Wally fails to trigger a Store/AMO Access fault and falls through to write status 2 (mismatch) into the `selfcheck_record`. The reference model, Spike (`$WALLY_SPIKE`), evaluates this correctly and flags a Store/AMO Access Fault (`mcause=7`), jumping to the `trap_handler`, handling the fault, and recording status 1 (pass). A positive control program (`control.elf`) performing a 4-byte store fully confined to PMP0 executes without trapping on both Spike and Wally.

The initial reproducer environment test failed because Spike (`htif`) could not parse the execution options correctly. Target options (i.e. `+signature=...`) must be provided after the ELF executable, whereas host options (i.e. `-m0x80000000...`, `--pc=...`, `--isa=...`) must appear before the executable. The reproducer contract was repaired to correct the Spike invocation sequence.
evidence: In M-mode (EffectivePrivilegeModeW == P.M_MODE), `EnforcePMP = (EffectivePrivilegeModeW != P.M_MODE) | MatchingL;`. Since `MatchingL = |(L & FirstMatch)` uses the start address's lock bit, an access starting in an unlocked TOR region evaluates `MatchingL` = 0. Therefore, `EnforcePMP` = 0. `PMPBoundaryStoreFault` and `PMPBoundaryLoadFault` both depend on `EnforcePMP & ...`, so they are forced to 0 regardless of `EndL` (the end address's lock bit) or `EndW` (the end address's write permission). Spike strictly adheres to the RISC-V Privileged Architecture (v20211203/v20240411, Section 3.7.1) and enforces permissions on any byte accessed, trapping if a multi-byte sequence encroaches into a locked, non-writable region.
